## Column {width=60%}

### Gen Z Market Analysis: Costco Strategy
This visualization analyzes consumer sentiment regarding "Roommate Family Plans" developed for the **Costco Wholesale** proposal.

```{r}
#| title: "Gen Z Interest in Shared Consumer Models"
library(ggplot2)
# Data representing your marketing strategy research
data <- data.frame(
  Strategy = c("Meal Prep", "Bulk Buying", "Shared Plans"), 
  Interest_Score = c(82, 74, 91)
)

ggplot(data, aes(x=Strategy, y=Interest_Score, fill=Strategy)) + 
  geom_bar(stat="identity") + 
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("#0A1628", "#C9A84C", "#1E3060")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(y = "Interest Level (%)", x = NULL)
```
